name: TempleOS Elephant
aliases: i like elephants and god likes elephants
description: Terry Davis's 16-color TempleOS drawing of a grey elephant standing in a yellow desert under a cyan sky, with a palm tree, grass and a stick, and the line "This is 16 color, pleasant to create. It would be unpleasant to draw with 16,777,216 colors."
usage: Simple beats complex: limits as a feature, low-fi art done with love. Also: "I like elephants and God likes elephants."

source.author: @Davisanism
source.example:
I often see small, low quality JPEGs of Terry Davis' famous TempleOS elephant meme being posted online, so I created a 4x larger PNG version using Terry's original BMP file.
